name: What is the role of a backsplash in a kitchen renovation?

mainEntity.name: What is the role of a backsplash in a kitchen renovation?

acceptedAnswer.text: A backsplash serves both functional and aesthetic purposes in a kitchen renovation. Functionally, it protects the walls behind your countertops from spills, splashes, and moisture, preventing damage and making cleanup easier. Aesthetically, it acts as a significant design element, tying together cabinetry, countertops, and flooring, and can provide a focal point or a subtle backdrop. As part of a full kitchen remodel with AKN Design Group, we integrate the backsplash material and design seamlessly into your overall vision.
acceptedAnswer.description: A backsplash protects kitchen walls from splashes and significantly enhances the room's design.
